video_title: How Sports Betting Cost an N.B.A. Player His Career | The New Yorker

quotes.speaker: Nick Berardini
quotes.summary_phrase: Jontay Porter's gambling scandal and potential prison sentence
quotes.excerpt: the canary in the coal mine for all this is a former professional basketball player named Jontay Porter
quotes.quote: The canary in the coal mine for all this is a former professional basketball player named Jontay Porter, who may go to prison. So let's look back and see how we got here.

quotes.speaker: Nick Berardini
quotes.summary_phrase: Jontay Porter's undrafted status and injury history
quotes.excerpt: Jontay goes undrafted after having been projected to be a top pick in the NBA draft
quotes.quote: Jontay goes undrafted after having been projected to be a top pick in the NBA draft because of his injuries. He finally trusted basketball, and then basketball had betrayed him.

quotes.speaker: Nick Berardini
quotes.summary_phrase: Jontay Porter's desire for financial independence
quotes.excerpt: He wants to make what he called NBA FU money without relying on basketball
quotes.quote: He wants to make what he called NBA FU money without relying on basketball. So he gets into day trading, and he starts playing on some illegal online casinos. He just didn't like the way that might look if that got out.

quotes.speaker: Nick Berardini
quotes.summary_phrase: Jontay Porter on his first major gambling loss
quotes.excerpt: That was my first big loss that just wrecked me

text_blocks.speaker: Jontay Porter
text_blocks.text: That was my first big loss that just wrecked me. And then I deleted the app, suspended my account that night. And then the next morning I was mad, and I came back for a vengeance.

text_blocks.speaker: Nick Berardini
text_blocks.text: At that point, he didn't really understand it, but he was already addicted.

quotes.speaker: Jontay Porter
quotes.summary_phrase: Jontay Porter on the thrill of gambling
quotes.excerpt: I think you're addicted to the thrill of the in-between when you don't know if it's going to win
quotes.quote: I think you're addicted to the thrill of the in-between when you don't know if it's going to win or lose. Just that suspension where your whole outcome is in question, eyes bloodshot, staring at a screen, your head's about to explode. And you win, and it's like, great, I can keep going now. And it feels really good for a second, but you want that feeling again.

quotes.speaker: Nick Berardini
quotes.summary_phrase: Jontay Porter's financial desperation and gambling cycle
quotes.excerpt: He panicked and realizes he needs a plan
quotes.quote: He panicked and realizes he needs a plan. That's what kicks off him starting to play ping-pong for about three days straight where he wins over a million dollars the same week that Jontay's brother Michael announced that he signed a 200 million dollar contract with the Denver Nuggets.

quotes.speaker: Nick Berardini
quotes.summary_phrase: Jontay Porter's manipulation of prop bets
quotes.excerpt: The plan is that they are going to manipulate the prop bets against Jontay's stats
quotes.quote: The pressure is mounting on Jontay. He's getting all kinds of threats. And that's when he comes up with a plan with this bookie that he's close to, Ammar Awawdeh. The plan is that they are going to manipulate the prop bets against Jontay's stats so that these people who he owes money to can place different bets across different sportsbooks to not trigger the betting monitors.

quotes.speaker: Jontay Porter
quotes.summary_phrase: Jontay Porter on the consequences of his gambling
quotes.excerpt: I'm glad all that stuff happened with the NBA and getting banned
quotes.quote: It's going to sound weird to say, but I'm glad all that stuff happened with the NBA and getting banned and the public shame and all my dirty laundry out there on the table, because my onion layers were so thick. If I didn't lose my NBA job, I would have lost my wife, and I would have lost my family support. I might have even lost my life.

quotes.speaker: Nick Berardini
quotes.summary_phrase: The broader NBA gambling conspiracy involving other players and coaches
quotes.excerpt: It turns out he was part of a much larger gambling conspiracy inside the NBA
quotes.quote: It turns out he was part of a much larger gambling conspiracy inside the NBA that had roped in Portland Trail Blazers head coach and NBA Hall of Famer Chauncey Billups, a former player and assistant coach named Damon Jones, and another active NBA player, a starting guard named Terry Rozier.
